requirements.requirement: There is an insect that is loved and enjoyed by many people in African countries and is particularly known as a local delicacy in northern South Africa.
The insect described in requirement 1 is known to have a habit of burrowing underground to pupate.
The insect described in requirement 1 is over-harvested and can be very expensive to buy.
A harvesting project was started in the early 2010s for the insect described in requirement 1, to benefit the people who eat it and the people who sell it.
There is an article published in the 2010s.
In that article, a person was quoted stating that the insect described in requirement 1 is a good source of protein.
Identify the person who was quoted in that article as stating that the insect is a good source of protein.
